content.title: Meet the Apollo Phantom 2.0: A New Era Begins
content.text: [Montreal, October 10th 2024] – Apollo Scooters is announcing the launch of its latest innovation, the Apollo Phantom 2.0: a legend, reborn. The Apollo Phantom was first released in 2021 and defined Apollo as a leader in the high-performance e-scooter space, marking the beginning of a revolution. Now, Apollo Scooters has re-designed this model from the ground up to be even more powerful, cutting-edge, and legendary. Legends are made, not born. The Apollo Phantom was the first iconic Apollo scooter, undergoing annual improvements for the past 3 years. But today, it’s been entirely re-designed to stand out in the performance category. The Apollo Phantom 2.0 is here to revolutionize the industry once more thanks to its high-end features that have been incorporated to make it a more powerful, comfortable and robust performance scooter: Legendary performance: The base version accelerates from 0 to 48 km/h (30 mph) in just 6 seconds and the Stellar configuration in just 4 seconds, thanks to the state-of-the-art MACH 3 controller. With advanced battery technology, riders can enjoy extended travel distances. The Stellar version is equipped with hydraulic and regenerative brakes, ensuring incredible stopping power. Legendary comfort: Offering unparalleled throttle response and control with Apollo's signature ProgressiV throttle, its unique design allows riders to experience an exceptionally smooth ride. Unlike other scooter brands, this technology makes it possible to have the smoothest acceleration and the most precise braking capabilities; without the abrupt movements found in competitor’s scooters. The Stellar version also features hydraulic suspension and, paired with 11 inch self-healing tires, makes the Phantom 2.0 one of the most comfortable performance scooters available. Legendary durability: Both versions of the Apollo Phantom 2.0 boast the newest DOT 2 display, NFC technology, and Apple FindMy integration alongside the signature LUDO mode. Triple-tested for endurance, it’s UL certified, carries an IP66 water-resistance rating, and tested to withstand toughest use in real-life conditions. This commitment to durability and innovation is why we're ready to offer a 2-year warranty, supported by reliable part availability, ensuring both long-term performance and peace of mind for all riders. The Apollo Phantom 2.0. Re-making a legend. The Apollo Phantom 2.0 is the perfect blend of the Apollo Phantom’s top-tier, legendary performance and the Apollo Pro’s award-winning design. It’s a game changer, combining raw power with stunning aesthetics. Available in both 52V and 60V configurations, both engineered for exceptional performance with the 60V tailored for conquering tougher terrains and even more thrills. Feel the excitement with the 52V version, hitting top speeds of 70 km/h (43 mph), offering an impressive range of 80 km (50 miles), powered by dual motors with total motor peak output of 3500W. It features dual spring suspension and a combination of disc and regenerative brakes for a smooth, controlled ride. For those who crave even more, the 60V version delivers. It reaches speeds of up to 85 km/h (49 mph) and covers distances up to 90 km (56 miles), all thanks to its dual motors with 6700W peak motor output. Experience unparalleled stability with dual hydraulic suspension while still being able to stop on a dime with its four piston hydraulic brakes. Both versions will, for the first time ever, come equipped with our new DOT 2 display for improved visibility; NFC technology to make it easier for you to lock and unlock your scooter, and Apple FindMy to provide peace of mind in knowing where your scooter is at all times. And last, but definitely not least, the Phantom 2.0 offers the acclaimed LUDO mode: accelerate from 0 to 48 km/h (30 mph) in a mere 6 seconds - engineered for true adventure lovers and thrill-enthusiasts! The Phantom 2.0 is here to redefine what a performance scooter can be—powerful, enduring and visually stunning. Get ready to experience legendary performance like never before. Two Versions - Same Legend In summary, the Apollo Phantom 2.0 will be available in two versions, both embodying the same legendary design and innovation, but with varying levels of power. The 60V (Stellar) model is engineered for the most extreme thrill-seekers, and the 52V (base) model has been designed for riders who want a balance between daily commuting and off-road adventures. Both versions offer versatility and performance, tailored to different riding styles. The specs are outlined below. Specs 52 V 60V (Stellar) Motors (peak) 2 x 1750W 2 x 3350W Top Speed 70 km/hr (44 mph) 85 km/hr (52 mph) Max Range 80km (50 miles) 90 km (56 miles) Brakes Mechanical disc brakes Hydraulic 4 piston brakes Battery type 52V 27Ah 60V 30Ah Suspension Dual spring Dual hydraulic DNM Tires 11” Self-healing 11” Self-healing Scooter Weight 40 kg (90 lb) 42 kg (93 lb) Max Load 150 kg (330 lb) 150 kg (330 lb) IP Rating IP66 IP66 Display DOT 2 display with NFC for locking/unlocking DOT 2 display with NFC for locking/unlocking The Apollo Promise, it makes a difference The Apollo Phantom 2.0, another one of Apollo Scooters' exceptional creations, comes with the commitment of the Apollo Promise, a pledge to deliver an unparalleled experience to all our riders. This commitment encompasses: Designed in Canada: Crafted in Canada, the Apollo Phantom 2.0 reflects a dedication to quality and innovation, ensuring riders experience the best in scooter technology. We’re proud to be close to our customers, ensuring we understand their needs and craft products that respond to them. Powered by MACH technology: Our scooters are powered by our MACH controller, an in-house controller to ensure our scooters are top-performing. Triple tested: Our scooter has undergone rigorous testing of over 10,000 kilometers (6,213 miles) on our testing rigs to ensure unmatched durability and reliability. However, this is not the only testing it will go through before final production. Following the successful approach we used for the Apollo Pro and Go models, we will also conduct real-life testing through our Early Access Program. In the coming weeks, a select number of customers will actively test the Phantom 2.0, collectively riding over 20,000 km (12,000 miles). This program has been fundamental in testing our scooters and ensuring they meet customer expectations through incorporating valuable customer feedback and insights, delivering the best riding experience possible. Finally, we’ve gone above and beyond to ensure our products continue to have the highest industry standards. All our scooters are UL certified and carry a IP66 water resistance rating. At Apollo Scooters, we believe that everyone deserves a top-notch experience without compromise. The Apollo Phantom 2.0 is available for pre-order as of today, October 10th 2024. The 52V version is expected to ship out in the first months 2025, and the Stellar (60V) later on in the year. For more information, please visit www.apolloscooters.co About Apollo Scooters: Apollo Scooters is a leading innovator in the electric scooter industry, dedicated to providing high-quality, performance-driven scooters for urban commuters and scooter enthusiasts. Based in Montreal, Canada, Apollo Scooters combines cutting-edge technology with Canadian craftsmanship to deliver a superior riding experience. Apollo Scooters www.apolloscooters.co
